title: Electrician Website Design (UK) — Fast, SEO-Driven Sites for Real Leads

facts.fact: The vendor describes its typical build turnaround as 10–14 days.
The vendor's kick-off call with the client is 20 minutes long and happens on Day 1 of the build.
In the vendor's build process, the design preview is scheduled for Days 3–5.
facts.quote: **Design preview (Days 3–5):** we build the home, one service page, and the contact flow.

facts.fact: In the vendor's build process, the full build of remaining pages is scheduled for Days 5–10.
facts.quote: **Full build (Days 5–10):** remaining pages, local SEO structure, schema, speed passes, form + spam protection, analytics.

facts.fact: In the vendor's build process, snagging and go-live is scheduled for Days 10–14.
facts.quote: **Snag & go-live (Days 10–14):** final tweaks, DNS/hosting, submit to Google, track calls and forms from day one.

facts.fact: The vendor's FAQ states that most builds go live in 10–14 days once content is agreed.
facts.quote: Most builds go live in **10–14 days** once content is agreed.

facts.fact: The vendor states that over half of an electrician's website traffic will be mobile.
facts.quote: Over half your traffic will be mobile.

facts.fact: The vendor offers a fixed-fee website build with an optional monthly care plan, but the page does not state any price.
facts.quote: **No mystery costs:** fixed-fee build, optional monthly care plan.

facts.fact: The vendor's standard site includes Local Business, Service, and FAQ structured data.
facts.quote: Structured data: Local Business + Service + FAQ schema for richer snippets.

facts.fact: The vendor's standard site includes a GDPR-compliant cookie banner along with privacy and terms pages.
facts.quote: GDPR-compliant cookie banner, privacy and terms pages.

facts.fact: The vendor says its review requests are sent without incentives.
facts.quote: (no incentives — just good timing and wording)

facts.fact: The vendor states it makes no 'rank #1 in a week' promises and no link-spam practices.
facts.quote: No gimmicks, no “rank #1 in a week” promises, no link-spam.
